justification: Names BOTH fix sites: (1) DatanodeDescriptor.resetBlocks() L313-318 omitting setOtherUsed(0) (while resetting the other five fields), and (2) HeartbeatManager.register() if(!d.isAlive) branch calling addDatanode->stats.add (capacityUsedOther += getOtherUsed(), L409) with the STALE value BEFORE updateHeartbeatState(EMPTY) resets it (L194/436), with the next heartbeat's subtract seeing 0 so the phantom is never removed -> metric high by one node's other-used (~3MB vs ~2MB). Correctly explains why only other-used drifts (others are zeroed by resetBlocks). Reasoned from the real DEBUG log, citing removeDeadDatanode (L4315) and 'node restarted' (L4468). No injected hints were present.
